tools.name: search_suggest
tools.description: Search Amazon for baby registry / shopping-list ideas. Rewrites queries with age/category cues. Use when building a recommendation list. Requires marketplace + locale.

tools.name: create_registry
tools.description: Create an empty baby registry / wishlist. Returns id, editToken, ownerUrl, shopUrl. Start of list-building. Requires marketplace + locale.

tools.name: create_and_fill_registry
tools.description: One-shot registry/shopping-list builder: create a registry and fill from ASINs/keywords/queries. Best tool for agents building a full baby list. Returns ownerUrl + shopUrl + editToken. Requires marketplace + locale.

tools.name: add_registry_item
tools.description: Add an item to an existing baby registry / wishlist. Prefer asin for tagged /dp/ links on amazon.se. Requires editToken, marketplace, locale.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search the curated baby registry catalog (100+ amazon.se essentials: sleep, feeding, diapering, gear, clothing, safety, bath, play). Returns products with asin + buyUrl. Use to pick items when building a shopping list / registry. Requires marketplace + locale.

tools.name: resolve_product
tools.description: Resolve ASIN, Amazon URL, or keywords to a curated buy URL on the selected marketplace (buyUrl + trackingTag; affiliateUrl is a compat alias).
